roles.definition: Sister is an adult feminine family-style role that may express chosen kinship, peer care, ageplay, or relational roleplay. It does not indicate a biological relationship unless the people separately state one.

roles.label: Sitter
roles.definition: Sitter is a supervision and care role for someone who watches over a little, pet, regressed adult, or other participant needing agreed support. Responsibilities and authority depend on the specific arrangement.

roles.label: Size Queen
roles.definition: Size Queen is celebratory sexual vocabulary for someone strongly drawn to large body parts, toys, insertables, or partners. It states a preference while leaving anatomy, activities, and practical limits unspecified.

roles.label: Skunkseeker
roles.definition: Skunkseeker describes someone especially attracted to skunk-themed partners, personas, furries, scents, markings, or play. The object of interest and whether it is erotic, aesthetic, or social varies.

roles.label: Slasher
roles.definition: Slasher is an edge-play or horror persona focused on blades, cutting imagery, pursuit, masks, staged menace, or cinematic violence. Any real sharp activity requires precise limits, skill, and risk planning.

roles.label: Smoothie
roles.definition: Smoothie is body-presentation vocabulary for someone who prefers a hairless or closely shaved appearance, often including intimate areas. The label concerns grooming aesthetics rather than gender, role direction, or availability.

roles.label: Snack
roles.definition: Snack is playful objectification or flirtation vocabulary for someone seen as especially tempting, attractive, or enjoyable in a limited encounter. It can be affectionate, sexual, teasing, or self-applied.

roles.label: Snow Bunny
roles.definition: Snow Bunny can describe someone drawn to winter sports or, in racialized dating slang, a white woman attracted to Black men. Because meanings differ sharply, users should establish their intended context.

roles.label: Social Swinger
roles.definition: Social Swinger participates in consensual partner-sharing spaces while valuing conversation, friendship, events, and community as much as sexual activity. Social connection may remain worthwhile even when no encounter occurs.

roles.label: Soft Boy
roles.definition: Soft Boy is a masculine persona emphasizing tenderness, emotional openness, gentleness, aesthetics, or vulnerability over conventional hardness. The label does not determine dominance, submission, sexuality, or sincerity.

roles.label: Soundtrix
roles.definition: Soundtrix is a sound-focused femme persona who uses voice, music, commands, rhythm, noise, or auditory sensation to shape erotic or power-oriented experiences. The exact medium and role direction can vary.

roles.label: Sovereign
roles.definition: Sovereign is a self-possessed authority persona emphasizing autonomy, command, dignity, and rule over a chosen domain. It may support power exchange or ceremonial identity without granting automatic authority over anyone.

roles.label: Spider
roles.definition: Spider is an arachnid-inspired persona associated with patience, webs, entrapment, many-limbed movement, venom, predation, or intricate creation. It may appear in pet play, fantasy, horror, or aesthetic identity.

roles.label: Squire
roles.definition: Squire is a courtly service persona who assists, trains under, equips, or accompanies a knight or other ranked figure. The role may combine devotion, practical duties, apprenticeship, and aspirational status.

roles.label: Squishy Toy
roles.definition: Squishy Toy is affectionate objectification vocabulary for someone who enjoys being squeezed, hugged, pressed, handled, or treated like a soft sensory plaything. Comfort and bodily pressure limits remain individual.

roles.label: Stay-at-Home Dominant
roles.definition: Stay-at-Home Dominant describes a person whose negotiated authority is expressed largely through household life, domestic routines, caregiving, management, or a home-centered relationship rather than public community visibility.

roles.label: Stay-at-Home Sub
roles.definition: Stay-at-Home Sub describes a submissive whose agreed service, support, domestic work, caregiving, or relationship participation is centered mainly in the home. The label does not define employment status by itself.

roles.label: Step-Brother
roles.definition: Step-Brother is an adult masculine family-role persona used in chosen-family, ageplay, or taboo-themed roleplay. It invokes a blended-family relationship without making claims about actual kinship or involving minors.

roles.label: Strap-On Domme
roles.definition: Strap-On Domme is a feminine Dominant whose style prominently includes directing or performing penetration with a strap-on. The activity focus does not define every part of her authority or sexuality.

roles.label: Struggle Slut
roles.definition: Struggle Slut is enthusiastic vocabulary for someone who enjoys consensual resistance, wrestling, escape attempts, capture, or being physically overpowered. Clear signals distinguish desired struggle from withdrawal of consent.

roles.label: Subby Buddy
roles.definition: Subby Buddy is an affectionate peer role for a fellow submissive who offers companionship, mutual encouragement, practical help, or shared reflection. It describes solidarity rather than authority over the other person.

roles.label: Submissive Sister
roles.definition: Submissive Sister combines feminine chosen-family or peer kinship with a submissive orientation. It may describe mutual support among submissives or a family-style place within a negotiated household hierarchy.

roles.label: Sugar Daddy
roles.definition: Sugar Daddy is an adult masculine provider role involving gifts, money, experiences, mentorship, or support within a mutually understood relationship. Financial terms do not erase either person's boundaries or agency.

roles.label: Superhero
roles.definition: Superhero is a heroic fantasy persona defined by extraordinary abilities, protective purpose, a distinctive identity, or dramatic responsibility. It may support rescue, rivalry, costume, transformation, or power-themed roleplay.

roles.label: Supplicant
roles.definition: Supplicant is a humble petitioner who approaches another person, deity persona, institution, or authority for favor, guidance, mercy, or acceptance. The role emphasizes asking and reverence rather than guaranteed submission.

roles.label: Swiss Army Slut
roles.definition: Swiss Army Slut humorously describes a sexually versatile person who enjoys filling many practical, erotic, or relational functions. Breadth of interest does not mean universal availability or lack of limits.

roles.label: Switchtress
roles.definition: Switchtress is feminine switch vocabulary for someone who moves between dominant and submissive, or giving and receiving, positions. The ornate title can add theatrical or commanding style to that flexibility.

roles.label: Taskmaster
roles.definition: Taskmaster is an authority role centered on assigning work, setting standards, monitoring completion, and applying agreed consequences or rewards. Its focus is structured performance rather than any particular activity.

roles.label: Teddy Bear
roles.definition: Teddy Bear is a warm, cuddly persona associated with comfort, softness, protection, affection, or a large gentle presence. It may be pet-like, ageplay-adjacent, romantic, or simply descriptive.

roles.label: Test Subject
roles.definition: Test Subject is a role for someone who volunteers to undergo experiments, trials, measurements, prototypes, or controlled procedures in scientific or clinical-style play. Protocol and consent define what testing permits.

roles.label: ThemDom
roles.definition: ThemDom is gender-neutral or nonbinary vocabulary for a Dominant who prefers they/them framing or a title outside masculine and feminine conventions. It describes negotiated authority without specifying style or activities.

roles.label: Thot
roles.definition: Thot is reclaimed or provocative slang for someone presenting as openly sexual, flirtatious, or promiscuous. It can be playful self-description or consensual degradation, but remains insulting when imposed.

roles.label: Throat Goat
roles.definition: Throat Goat is boastful sexual vocabulary for someone known for enthusiasm or skill in deep oral stimulation. The title communicates a specialty without creating expectations of access or performance.

roles.label: Throat Slayer
roles.definition: Throat Slayer is an intense oral-sex persona emphasizing forceful use, depth, stamina, or a dramatic sense of conquest. It may describe the active partner, with meaning clarified between participants.

roles.label: Tickle Toy
roles.definition: Tickle Toy is consensual objectification vocabulary for someone who enjoys being used as the recipient of tickling. Restraint, intensity, vulnerable areas, breathing, and stop signals require advance agreement.

roles.label: Toilet Slave
roles.definition: Toilet Slave is an extreme degradation or bodily-fluid role in which a submissive is treated symbolically or literally as a toilet. Hygiene, health risks, exact acts, and hard limits need explicit negotiation.

roles.label: Trinket Goblin
roles.definition: Trinket Goblin is a playful collector persona delighted by small objects, shiny finds, keepsakes, gifts, or scavenged treasures. It combines goblin mischief with an urge to gather and display meaningful items.

roles.label: Ukete
roles.definition: Ukete is rope vocabulary derived from Japanese tying communities for a person receiving rope while actively contributing movement, expression, and embodied response. The role is collaborative rather than a passive object.

roles.label: Uncle
roles.definition: Uncle brings a mature masculine relative persona to adult chosen-family, caregiving, ageplay, or relational scenes. Depending on context, the tone may be protective, indulgent, authoritative, teasing, or informally supportive.

roles.label: Vampire Bait
roles.definition: Vampire Bait is prey or offering vocabulary for someone who invites attention from a vampire persona, often through pursuit, temptation, feeding fantasy, or deliberate vulnerability. It does not imply unrestricted access.

roles.label: Vampire Concubine
roles.definition: Vampire Concubine is an intimate companion persona attached to a vampire figure through devotion, erotic service, status, feeding, or supernatural court imagery. The role may include privilege alongside dependence.

roles.label: Vivisector
roles.definition: Vivisector is an extreme medical-horror persona who imagines cutting into or examining a living subject. It belongs to carefully negotiated fantasy or simulation; the label does not make actual severe injury acceptable.

roles.label: Waif
roles.definition: Waif is a delicate, displaced, vulnerable, or ethereal persona that invites themes of rescue, neglect, resilience, or being taken in. Its aesthetic does not establish helplessness or consent to caretaking.

roles.label: Warlock
roles.definition: Warlock is a magical practitioner persona associated with spells, pacts, forbidden knowledge, ritual power, or occult command. It can be heroic, sinister, dominant, submissive, or independent according to the fiction.

roles.label: Warlord
roles.definition: Warlord is a martial authority persona who commands fighters, territory, resources, or campaigns through strength and strategy. It supports conquest and hierarchy themes within negotiated fantasy rather than real-world entitlement.

roles.label: Whip Wielder
roles.definition: Whip Wielder is an impact specialist who handles whips for sensation, performance, discipline, or technical practice. The label identifies the implement and active position without guaranteeing expertise or broader dominance.

roles.label: Whore
roles.definition: Whore is a historically stigmatizing sexual label that some adults reclaim for erotic identity, promiscuity, sex work, or consensual degradation. Self-chosen use does not make it appropriate to impose on others.

roles.label: Wood Nymph
roles.definition: Wood Nymph is a forest-spirit persona associated with trees, wilderness, beauty, playfulness, sensuality, or protective connection to a particular natural place. It may support fantasy, ritual, or aesthetic expression.

roles.label: Zaddy
roles.definition: Zaddy is admiring slang for a stylish, confident, attractive, or charismatic mature masculine person. It can overlap with Daddy energy but does not inherently imply caregiving, age play, or authority.

roles.label: Zombie
roles.definition: Zombie is an undead persona characterized by decay, altered awareness, hunger, infection, relentless movement, or loss of ordinary humanity. It may be used in horror, pursuit, transformation, or objectification play.

roles.label: Zucchini
roles.definition: Zucchini is playful vocabulary that may evoke a phallic vegetable, insertion theme, food play, gardening humor, or an intentionally absurd persona. Its intended meaning needs to be supplied by the user.
